Measured on the Starry Night's canvas face. By day the drum may exceed it (sheet 4): measured and reported, never tuned.

design.note: At night and at overcast reference moments the canopy's mean luminance is at least the drum inner leaf's: a glowing ceiling (the board). Clear-sky moments exempt on the sunlit third of the drum. Measured, never tuned.
The ribs read as pearl structure against the canopy, never as silhouettes: their room faces at least 0.25 x the canopy's mean behind them.
At night the canopy is the brightest extended surface in the room (luminaire diffusers excepted).
